headline: Merging SpaceX and Tesla would be a "good idea," Musk says
standfirst: Elon Musk said Tuesday that he would like to see the consolidation of his business empire by formally merging his two largest companies, SpaceX and Tesla.
body_markdown:
Elon Musk said Tuesday that he would like to see the consolidation of his business empire by formally merging his two largest companies, SpaceX and Tesla. "Do I think it would be a good idea? Yes," Musk said of a potential merger. (Ars Technica)

**Axios** adds: SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to discuss a potential merger — and Elon Musk thinks "it's a good idea," the CEO of both companies said Tuesday. Why it matters: SpaceX and Tesla have increasingly been collaborating on chips and AI projects — and Musk leads both companies — prompting widespread speculation that they could join forces.

**The Hill** adds: Elon Musk said Tuesday that his two companies, SpaceX and Tesla, have formed independent special committees to discuss the potential merger, calling it “a good idea.” “I think it would be a good ​idea, but it’s really up to the special committees of both companies,” Musk told investors on a conference call, according to a…

**Engadget** adds: SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to discuss a merger, but Elon Musk says it's not a certainty.

**BBC News US & Canada** adds: Musk says there's "a lot to be gained" by combining the firms in what would be the biggest merger in history.

This digest was assembled automatically from reporting by The Guardian Science, Financial Times, The Hill, Semafor, BBC News US & Canada, Engadget, The Guardian Business, South China Morning Post, Ars Technica and Axios. Follow the source links below for the full coverage.
